<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update sys_domain="global" table="catalog_script_client"><catalog_script_client action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><active>true</active><applies_catalog>true</applies_catalog><applies_extended>false</applies_extended><applies_req_item>false</applies_req_item><applies_sc_task>false</applies_sc_task><applies_target_record>false</applies_target_record><applies_to>item</applies_to><cat_item display_value="Order AI Devices">747965e9c30872103b6237cc0501315d</cat_item><cat_variable>IO:edd92184c374b2107de9bb459901312a</cat_variable><condition/><description/><field/><global>true</global><isolate_script>true</isolate_script><messages/><name>Set Short Description</name><order/><published_ref/><script><![CDATA[function onChange(control, oldValue, newValue, isLoading) {
    if (isLoading || !newValue) {
        g_form.setValue('description', ''); // Clear the catalog Description variable if nothing selected
        return;
    }

    // Fetch AI Device description via Script Include
    var ga = new GlideAjax('AI_DeviceUtils'); // Must be client-callable and in same scope
    ga.addParam('sysparm_name', 'getDescription'); 
    ga.addParam('sys_id', newValue); // sys_id of the selected device
    ga.getXMLAnswer(function(answer) {
        if (answer) {
            g_form.setValue('description', answer); // Set catalog Description variable
        } else {
            g_form.setValue('description', 'Description not available');
        }
    });
}
]]></script><sys_class_name>catalog_script_client</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2025-10-22 07:21:53</sys_created_on><sys_domain>global</sys_domain><sys_domain_path>/</sys_domain_path><sys_id>eccabf6cc3f0f6107de9bb45990131a0</sys_id><sys_mod_count>7</sys_mod_count><sys_name>Set Short Description</sys_name><sys_overrides/><sys_package display_value="ServicenowApllication" source="x_15581_servicenow">95b452a4c30432103b6237cc050131a6</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="ServicenowApllication">95b452a4c30432103b6237cc050131a6</sys_scope><sys_update_name>catalog_script_client_eccabf6cc3f0f6107de9bb45990131a0</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2025-10-22 07:54:46</sys_updated_on><table/><type>onChange</type><ui_type>10</ui_type><va_supported>true</va_supported><variable_set/><view/></catalog_script_client></record_update>
